text:
alex: Heads up — noticed a class of tenant credit spikes after we rolled the API client key rotation patch. invoice preview has duplicate token counts for the same logical request. Can we triage?

jamie: Seen this pattern before with retry storms + new key handshake. Do you have an example log?

alex: Paste: ```
metering_event tenant=tenant-123 req_id=abc123 client_key=old->new retry=1 ts=2026-03-23T12:01:03Z tokens=145
metering_event tenant=tenant-123 req_id=abc123 client_key=new retry=2 ts=2026-03-23T12:01:18Z tokens=145
```
Same logical prompt, same req_id on client side, but our edge is attributing them twice because the routing fingerprint changed when key swapped.

priya: Oof. We currently use fingerprint=(client_key, route_hint, first_byte_ts) for attribution. Key rotation changes fingerprint so dedupe window doesn't catch.

jamie: Right. Retries can occur >5s after initial, and our dedupe window is 5s. Backoffs push second event outside window.

sasha: Two obvious approaches: extend dedupe window (worse for memory), or switch to dedupe key that includes client-generated idempotency header if present.

mike: From billing side: once invoice lines materialize, fixing later is a pain. Prefer preventing duplicate events at ingest. We need a short-term mitigation + longer-term SDK contract.

alex: Proposal: 1) Add required X-Client-Request-Id header (SDK update) that we use as canonical dedupe key. 2) For legacy clients, add tenant+session+prompt-hash fallback. 3) Increase dedupe window to 1 minute for events that have matching req_id across different fingerprints as a temporary safety net.

priya: For (2) need a deterministic prompt-hash that is stable across minor whitespace differences? We could normalize and sha256. But collisions risk small.

jamie: Implementation note: dedupe lookup should be namespace-scoped by tenant to avoid cross-tenant collisions. Also TTL for dedupe keys should be configurable per-tenant.

mike: Agreed. For invoices we can run a corrective job to reconcile obvious duplicates in last 24h where token counts identical and req_id reused. But manual adjustments will be needed for edge cases.

billing-bot: Created metric metering.dedupe_fallbacks.count and alert when >100/h for a tenant. Dashboards updated under Billing -> Metering -> Dedupe.

alex: Can we surface a console card showing "dedupe candidate rate" per route so customers can see if their SDK version is causing churn?

sasha: UX: add a small warning in invoice preview if dedupe_fallbacks > threshold with an explain link. That should reduce support load.

jamie: Dev plan: make X-Client-Request-Id required in our client-sdk v2.1, server will accept but not require for 2 weeks, then enforce. Add server-side heuristic path that checks cross-fingerprint matches and sets a soft-dedup flag.

priya: Server schema change: metering_event.addl_headers.x_client_req_id (nullable). We'll need to backfill parsers in the ingest path.

alex: Who owns rollout? I can take ingest runtime changes, sasha owns console cards, mike owns reconciliation job, jamie owns SDK changes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: ingest-runtime change -> eng-platform-canary at 2026-03-24T10:00Z, full rollout 48h after if no spikes.

mike: Can we also add a short-lived ML-based fingerprint similarity check? If two events are >95% match on normalized prompt and same tenant in 2m window, flag and hold for 30s to let dedupe check complete. Lower false positives by requiring identical token counts.

priya: That sounds computable but beware latency impact. Maybe do it only for events that would otherwise cause >5% SaaS cost delta in an invoice preview for a tenant.

alex: Action items: 1) jamie - SDK header + release notes (ETA 3 days). 2) jamie/priya - server accept header + fallback dedupe (PR this week). 3) sasha - console card + invoice preview warning (mockups by EOD). 4) mike - reconciliation job and alert tuning (start). 5) alex - monitor canary, roll back if dedupe_fallbacks > 500/h.

sasha: I'll add the dashboard mock as a quick prototype. Prefer the warning link to point at support article + SDK upgrade guide.

jamie: I'll include upgrade opt-in flag in SDK so customers can opt into sending X-Client-Request-Id early. Also publish migration checklist.

alex: Thanks. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:

mike: Thanks — will coordinate with finance for any interim credit adjustments if we see material overbilling.

alex: Re-check in 24h after canary starts.

jamie: ACK.

billing-bot: Alert rule rule/id=dedupe_fallbacks_high created: notify #eng-platform + #billing when tenant rate > 200/hr.

alex: (thread pinned)
